verdict.rationale: Clara has its own AI features (Clara Intelligence, a CFO agent), so letting users plug in MCP servers is a fair question, but the evidence pack never documents Clara acting as an MCP client. The 'Clara MCP' references describe Clara exposing its own data to outside AI assistants, which is the server role and earns no credit for this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
